author: opus-5.5
body:
[opus 5.5] Landed as a66bd0b (vibe-talk: check the credential before reading the request on every route).

What changed: every bearer-token /api/ handler takes ReadScope or WriteScope as its first extractor after State, so Path, Query, Json and Bytes never answer a caller without the right credential. The two ticket routes take SpeechTicket, which checks the ticket is live before the query or body is read. Ingest already authenticated first. Authorized callers get exactly the statuses they got before.

Routing enumeration, fixed here rather than filed separately: routing answered before any handler, so an anonymous caller could map the API from 404 versus 405 and the allow header. src/http/bearer_layer.rs now answers any /api/ request without a browser token with the same 401 a route gives (status, headers, body). The ingest and ticket routes are exempt for their own method only. It wraps the router from outside, because Router::layer runs after routing and let the 405 path add allow to the 401. With a token, routing answers as before.

Review evidence:
- First independent review (extractors): findings fixed. The inventory parser fails closed and is backed by a 405 probe, the play route's bad query reaches Query, the authorized check covers more callers, and the docs are narrowed. Its differential of 205 authorized requests, well formed and malformed, gave identical status and error code before and after.
- Second independent review (the layer): one blocking finding, the allow header on the anonymous 401 under Router::layer. Fixed with the outer-router wrap. The map test now compares headers against the ingest route's own 401, and HEAD with a live ticket is checked; allocation-free path matching was also adopted.
- Two review notes are recorded rather than changed. Anonymous POST /api/v1/live/events answers 404 ingest_disabled when ingest is not configured; that predates this change and belongs to that exempt route's own credential design. Raw header order on the wire differs between the ingest route's 401 and the layer's; this is cosmetic, on a documented exempt route.

Controls:
- Against the previous handlers, the refusal test reports 183 offending requests across 31 routes, and the authorized test passes unchanged.
- Mutations are caught: layer removed (532 probes), layer on the inner router (allow header), generic 401 body, HEAD dropped from the ticket exemption, extra route forms (patch, any, route_service), and play reordered.

Checks on the final tree: cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast (26 targets) and check_client_names all pass. make validate-all is run on the exact tree containing this closure before it is pushed; the push happens only if it passes.
